text:
Alex K.: taking handoff — I'm stepping out for the next 4h, handing primary to Maria. active incident: INC-2026-789 (cache memory pressure causing OOM evictions on live-serving pool). PagerDuty triggered ~1765001000.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 — cache.memory_pressure -> severity: high. Affected service: runtime/kv-cache (hosted).

Alex K.: TL;DR: multiple hosts in shard-3 are dropping into OOM OOM_kill, we see elevated tail latency for hosted text-gen routes (p95 > 450ms -> customers report timeouts). Some small customer sessions in EU experiencing errors. No full region outage.

Maria T.: taking primary. quick questions: what's current mitigation and what still needs to be done?

Alex K.: Mitigations in progress: 1) rolling restart of problematic agents in shard-3 (done for 3/5, in-progress for remaining) 2) temporarily raised eviction threshold and enabled forced compaction on the problematic hosts 3) scaled up cache pool by +2 nodes (auto-scaler didn't kick due to quota) 4) disabled prefetcher on affected hosts to reduce churn.

Alex K.: Commands & dashboards: Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/services/cache -> dashboard "KV Cache: Memory & OOM". Check logs with:
```bash
kubectl -n runtime logs -l shard=shard-3 -c cache-agent --tail=200 | grep -E "OOM|evict|compaction"
```
And check pod memory RSS:
```bash
kubectl top pods -n runtime -l shard=shard-3
```

Alex K.: Current observed metrics: host-12 mem_rss ~94% -> OOM events at 97%; host-14 mem_rss ~88%; request queueing increased on host-12 -> spillover to host-14. Customer error rate (5xx) bump from 0.2% -> 2.7% on text-gen-route B.

Sam R.: I can continue watching restarts and watch for crashloops. I also opened a cloud quota ticket to request +2 temporary GPU/hugepages (ref #CLOUD-1123).

Lucy S.: Noted. Runbook pointer: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/cache-oom.md — follow the "scale-and-drain" section, steps 2b and 3c are important (do not restart coordinator until drain finishes). Also check the "fallback-routing" policy in console in case we need to divert traffic to dedicated model variants.

Alex K.: Known risk: if a restart fails on host-13 it will cause transient latency spikes; do rolling restarts with 30s gap and monitor p50/p95. Avoid restarting two hosts in same AZ simultaneously.

Maria T.: Coverage gaps: APAC night window (00:00-06:00 UTC) is low headcount — FYI I can't guarantee coverage for the last 90min of my shift (03:30-04:00 UTC) due to scheduled call. We need someone to cover that slot or enable auto-escalation to infra on-call.

oncall-pager: Reminder: APAC oncall is @sam.r (pagerduty) for 00:00-08:00 UTC.

Maria T.: I'll continue primary through my shift until 03:30 UTC. Sam, can you cover 03:30-04:15 if the incident is still active? If not, set auto-escalation to infra.

Sam R.: I can cover 03:30-04:15. If I need to escalate, I'll page infra and tag @infra-oncall.

Alex K.: Customer comms: CS drafted an update for impacted customers, awaiting approval. Internal flagging: tag incident with "partial-customer-impact" and list customers A42, C33 for targeted follow-up.

Maria T.: Actions for next shift (priority): 1) finish rolling restarts on shard-3 (ensure drain complete), 2) monitor OOM events and revert eviction threshold only after stability for 10m, 3) keep prefetcher disabled on affected hosts, 4) verify that the autoscaler ticket resolves and nodes remain up.

Alex K.: Quick troubleshooting snippets: if you see repeated compaction logs like:
```
[cache-agent] compact() took 1200ms, freed 0kb -> indicates fragmentation, consider triggering forced compaction: /usr/local/bin/force-compact --shard shard-3 --host host-12
```
If forced compaction doesn't reduce RSS within 2 min, proceed with drained restart.

Lucy S.: Also watch for increased KV cache miss-rate after forced compaction; if miss-rate > 15% for >5min, enable fallback routing to model-variant "gen-medium" to reduce memory pressure (console -> routing -> fallback -> enable).

Maria T.: Acknowledged. I'm going to run the remaining restarts, I'll post progress updates here.

Alex K.: Thanks, leaving pager and docs up-to-date. Tagging PD incident: https://pd.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-789

Maria T.: update: restarted host-13 (drain completed) — observed one transient p95 spike, now stable. Remaining host: host-12 (high RSS). Running forced compaction now.

Sam R.: watching logs, compaction started on host-12. If compaction fails, I'll coordinate restart + drain.

Maria T.: compaction freed ~120MB so far, RSS down from 94% -> 83%. No new OOMs in last 4m. Bringing this to monitoring state.

Alex K.: Excellent. Final handoff note: Maria primary, Sam secondary, Lucy on escalation. APAC coverage confirmed for 03:30-04:15 by Sam. If anything regresses, follow runbook and escalate to infra-oncall.

Maria T.: I accept handoff. will update incident timeline and close handoff thread. :white_check_mark:
